draft.emotion: warm and affectionate, speaking of one's own child with quiet pride
notes: The feminine is 'la figlia' (daughter). The masculine plural 'i figli' refers either to sons or to sons and daughters together.
Do not confuse 'figlio' (someone's son or child of any age, even an adult) with 'bambino' (a young child by age).
